membership.pathNote: New members join any project team after pitches and onboarding. We match interests and experience, but all levels are welcome.

meetings.firstMeeting: Project pitches + onboarding to tools and workflows.
meetings.mandatory: Weekly updates + team work time documented via issues/PRs.

meetings.social: Leisure events to build community; no project work expected.

elections.summary: Spring elections each year. Eligibility: President ≥ 2 semesters experience; other Executive Board roles ≥ 1 semester.
